strategy_roster.name: ADX Simple Trend
strategy_roster.notes: ADX(25) strength and its one-bar rise retain the documented trend requirement; positive price ROC is a proxy for +DI above -DI. The separate +DI/-DI lines and original risk controls are unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: ASCV Pivot Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close,donchian_high_prev(high,20)) and sma(close,10) > sma(close,40) and std(close,10) > 0.0005 and volume_ratio(volume,10) > 1
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(10/40), standard deviation(10)>0.0005, and volume_ratio(10)>1 retain the documented filter values; RSI(14)<40 is a stochastic-exit proxy. Proprietary ASCTrend/BrainTrend, daily pivots, hours, point targets, and trailing are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Weighted MA Slope
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(12) of price multiplied by volume_ratio(12) is an explicit normalized VWMA proxy; positive one- and two-bar slopes represent two rising bars. The documented 1% stop and 2% target are retained.

strategy_roster.name: Hedge Average
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(10/20) open-versus-close averages are explicit fallbacks for the unnamed Period1/Period2 values and preserve the hedge-average long condition. Trading hours, absolute-price protection, trailing, and money-target controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Scalper Strategy (API/3858)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(6)/SMA(12) filter and six-bar breakout window are retained directly. Money-management modes and the 50-point stop are not percentage/DSL fields; the opposite range break is the long exit proxy.

strategy_roster.name: Channel Scalper
strategy_roster.notes: The midpoint plus/minus 2*ATR(14) channel is an explicit fallback for the unspecified ATR period and multiplier. Channel bands act as dynamic stops, while timeframe and reverse-order state are not modeled.

strategy_roster.name: E9 Shark-32 Pattern
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish close above a prior three-bar high is a deterministic proxy for the three-candle pattern breakout, with the prior-low break as exit. Shark-32 geometry, mirrored targets, and unspecified percentage stop parameters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Potential Entries
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish completed candle with positive one-bar momentum is a state-free proxy for the documented two-candle momentum/reversal family. Exact pattern side, candle-pair offsets, and pair-extreme stops are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: VQ EA
strategy_roster.notes: Smoothed median price uses SMA(5) versus SMA(20) as a direction-change proxy for the unavailable VQ line; the 20-bar comparison is an explicit fallback. FilterPoints, 60-point stop, take-profit, trailing, and 1-hour timeframe are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Zone Recovery Hedge
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14)<30 is the long-side oversold trigger when the source's RSI multi-timeframe mode is selected; RSI>70 exits. The anchor/recovery grid, alternating volume ladder, money targets, manual mode, timers, and risk guard are stateful and omitted.
